description: Kits (spec/cli/kits.md). readKit: the valid kit is read; each broken case starts from a copy of the valid kit, applies edits (text replacements in a file), files (whole file replaced) and remove (files deleted), and must fail with the message. A case with place puts the copy at that path below a catalogue root and reads it as installedKits does.

kit.title: Local medallion on DuckDB
kit.summary: Bronze, silver and gold tables in one DuckDB file.

broken.name: no kit.yaml
broken.error: kit.yaml is missing. A kit folder needs kit.yaml, standard.yaml, platform.yaml, project.yaml and README.md.

broken.name: kit.yaml is not a mapping
broken.error: kit.yaml: it must be a list of keys and values, such as id: and version:.

broken.name: unknown key
broken.error: kit.yaml: unknown key "titel". Check its spelling or remove it.

broken.name: unknown key under requires
broken.error: kit.yaml: unknown key "requires.node". Only "ingestron" is allowed there.

broken.name: missing title
broken.error: kit.yaml: "title" is missing. Add it.

broken.name: missing requires
broken.error: kit.yaml: "requires" is missing. Add it, such as requires: { ingestron: ">=2.4.0" }.

broken.name: requires without ingestron
broken.error: kit.yaml: "requires.ingestron" is missing. Add it, such as ">=2.4.0".

broken.name: title is not text
broken.error: kit.yaml: "title" must be text.

broken.name: packs is not a list
broken.error: kit.yaml: "packs" must be a list of pack ids, such as [duckdb@2].

broken.name: no packs
broken.error: kit.yaml: "packs" is empty. List the packs the kit uses, such as [duckdb@2].

broken.name: pack without a major version
broken.error: kit.yaml: pack "duckdb" is not <id>@<major>. Write it as duckdb@2.

broken.name: maintainers is not a list
broken.error: kit.yaml: "maintainers" must be a list of names, such as [ingestron].

broken.name: id is not platform/name
broken.error: kit.yaml: id "local-medallion" is not <platform>/<name>. Use lower-case words joined by "-", such as "duckdb/local-medallion".

broken.name: id has capitals
broken.error: kit.yaml: id "duckdb/Local-Medallion" is not <platform>/<name>. Use lower-case words joined by "-", such as "duckdb/local-medallion".

broken.name: id platform is not the first pack
broken.error: kit.yaml: id "databricks/local-medallion" starts with "databricks", but the first pack is "duckdb@2". Start the id with the first pack's name, or put that pack first.

broken.name: version is not a date
broken.error: kit.yaml: version "next" is not a date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD-preview for a preview kit.

broken.name: version has no day
broken.error: kit.yaml: version "2026-11" is not a date. Use YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM-DD-preview for a preview kit.

broken.name: version is not a real date
broken.error: kit.yaml: version "2026-02-30" is not a real date. Check the month and the day.

broken.name: features is neither ga nor preview
broken.error: kit.yaml: features must be "ga" or "preview".

broken.name: ga with a preview version
broken.error: kit.yaml: features is "ga", but version "2026-11-01-preview" ends in -preview. Set features: preview, or drop the suffix from the version.

broken.name: preview without the suffix
broken.error: kit.yaml: features is "preview", but version "2026-11-01" does not end in -preview. Add the suffix to the version, or set features: ga.

broken.name: range is a word
broken.error: kit.yaml: requires.ingestron "latest" is not a version range. Use >=X.Y.Z, ^X.Y.Z or ~X.Y.Z, such as ">=2.4.0".

broken.name: range with two parts
broken.error: kit.yaml: requires.ingestron ">=2.4.0 <3.0.0" is not a version range. Use >=X.Y.Z, ^X.Y.Z or ~X.Y.Z, such as ">=2.4.0".

broken.name: range without a patch
broken.error: kit.yaml: requires.ingestron ">=2.4" is not a version range. Use >=X.Y.Z, ^X.Y.Z or ~X.Y.Z, such as ">=2.4.0".

broken.name: replaces is not a version
broken.error: kit.yaml: replaces "last-week" is not a version. Use null, or the previous version, such as 2026-10-01.

broken.name: replaces is the same version
broken.error: kit.yaml: replaces "2026-11-01" must be earlier than version "2026-11-01".

broken.name: replaces is a later version
broken.error: kit.yaml: replaces "2026-12-01" must be earlier than version "2026-11-01".

broken.name: no standard.yaml
broken.error: standard.yaml is missing. A kit folder needs kit.yaml, standard.yaml, platform.yaml, project.yaml and README.md.

broken.name: no platform.yaml
broken.error: platform.yaml is missing. A kit folder needs kit.yaml, standard.yaml, platform.yaml, project.yaml and README.md.

broken.name: no project.yaml
broken.error: project.yaml is missing. A kit folder needs kit.yaml, standard.yaml, platform.yaml, project.yaml and README.md.

broken.name: no README.md
broken.error: README.md is missing. A kit folder needs kit.yaml, standard.yaml, platform.yaml, project.yaml and README.md.

broken.name: standard.yaml is not a mapping
broken.error: standard.yaml: it must be a list of keys and values, such as packs: and origin:.

broken.name: standard packs differ
broken.error: standard.yaml: packs is [duckdb@2, adf@2], but kit.yaml says [duckdb@2]. Make the two lists the same.

broken.name: standard has no packs
broken.error: standard.yaml: packs is [], but kit.yaml says [duckdb@2]. Make the two lists the same.

broken.name: standard has no origin
broken.error: standard.yaml: origin must say standard: duckdb/local-medallion and version: 2026-11-01, the same as kit.yaml. Add it.

broken.name: standard origin names another version
broken.error: standard.yaml: origin must say standard: duckdb/local-medallion and version: 2026-11-01, the same as kit.yaml. Correct it.

broken.name: standard origin names another kit
broken.error: standard.yaml: origin must say standard: duckdb/local-medallion and version: 2026-11-01, the same as kit.yaml. Correct it.

broken.name: folder is not named by the version
broken.error: The kit is in duckdb/local-medallion/2026-10-01, but kit.yaml says duckdb/local-medallion/2026-11-01. Move the folder to duckdb/local-medallion/2026-11-01, or correct id and version.

broken.name: folder is not named by the id
broken.error: The kit is in duckdb/other/2026-11-01, but kit.yaml says duckdb/local-medallion/2026-11-01. Move the folder to duckdb/local-medallion/2026-11-01, or correct id and version.
